newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada again sets specials at 4.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada again sets specials at 4.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Tuesday conducted a second round of purchase and resale agreements at 4.25 percent in the money market, traders said.
"It's just bid at the upper end of the band today. He's (central bank) just coming in to ease the pain for those who are still looking. I wouldn't read into it at all," said one money market trader.

The central bank intervened to add liquidity to the market for a second time after the call loan rate continued to be bid at 4.25 percent, at the top of the Bank of Canada 3.75-4.25 percent target range.
After the intervention, the call loan rate continued to trade at about 4.25 percent.
